sign-in, and there never has been one. The request goes to

at a different address searching that same book still gets their results, and
still without signing in — and the address being refused can still open the

require "securerandom"

class SearchRateLimiter
  LIMIT = 30
  WINDOW = 1.minute

  REDIS_SLIDING_WINDOW_SCRIPT = <<~LUA
    local key = KEYS[1]
    local now = tonumber(ARGV[1])
    local window = tonumber(ARGV[2])
    local limit = tonumber(ARGV[3])
    local member = ARGV[4]

    redis.call("ZREMRANGEBYSCORE", key, "-inf", now - window)
    if redis.call("ZCARD", key) >= limit then
      return 0
    end

    redis.call("ZADD", key, now, member)
    redis.call("EXPIRE", key, math.ceil(window))
    return 1
  LUA

  @mutex = Mutex.new
  @fallback_store = ActiveSupport::Cache::MemoryStore.new

  class << self
    def allow?(ip, now: Time.current.to_f)
      key = cache_key_for(ip)
      store = active_store

      if redis_store?(store)
        allowed = allow_via_redis?(store, key, now)
        return allowed unless allowed.nil?
      end

      allow_via_memory?(store_for_memory(store), key, now)
    end

    def reset!
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @fallback_store.clear
      end
    end

    private
      def active_store
        Rails.cache
      end

      def redis_store?(store)
        defined?(ActiveSupport::Cache::RedisCacheStore) && store.is_a?(ActiveSupport::Cache::RedisCacheStore)
      end

      def store_for_memory(store)
        if store.is_a?(ActiveSupport::Cache::NullStore) || redis_store?(store)
          @fallback_store
        else
          store
        end
      end

      def cache_key_for(ip)
        "rate-limit:books/searches:#{ip.presence || "unknown"}"
      end

      def allow_via_redis?(store, key, now)
        normalized_key = store.send(:normalize_key, key, {})
        result = store.redis.then do |client|
          client = client.node_for(normalized_key) if defined?(::Redis::Distributed) && client.is_a?(::Redis::Distributed)
          client.eval(
            REDIS_SLIDING_WINDOW_SCRIPT,
            keys: [ normalized_key ],
            argv: [ now, WINDOW.to_f, LIMIT, "#{now}:#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}" ]
          )
        end
        result == 1
      rescue ::Redis::BaseError, ConnectionPool::Error, ConnectionPool::TimeoutError
        nil
      end

      def allow_via_memory?(memory_store, key, now)
        cutoff = now - WINDOW.to_f

        @mutex.synchronize do
          timestamps = Array(memory_store.read(key)).select { |timestamp| timestamp > cutoff }
          if timestamps.size >= LIMIT
            false
          else
            timestamps << now
            memory_store.write(key, timestamps, expires_in: WINDOW)
            true
          end
        end
      end
  end
end

require "test_helper"

class Books::Searches::RateLimitingTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  setup do
    SearchRateLimiter.reset!
    Leaf.reindex_all

    @handbook = books(:handbook)
    @manual = books(:manual)
    @handbook.update!(published: true)
    @manual.update!(published: true)
  end

  teardown do
    SearchRateLimiter.reset!
  end

  test "allows 30 unauthenticated searches in one minute and refuses the rest with 429" do
    attacker_ip = "198.51.100.10"

    30.times do
      post book_search_path(@handbook), params: { search: "Thanks" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
      assert_response :success
    end

    5.times do
      post book_search_path(@handbook), params: { search: "Thanks" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
      assert_response :too_many_requests
      assert_not response.redirect?
      assert_not response.server_error?
    end
  end

  test "counts requests across different published books for the same address" do
    attacker_ip = "198.51.100.11"

    15.times do
      post book_search_path(@handbook), params: { search: "Thanks" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
      assert_response :success
    end

    15.times do
      post book_search_path(@manual), params: { search: "Manual" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
      assert_response :success
    end

    post book_search_path(@manual), params: { search: "Manual" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
    assert_response :too_many_requests
  end

  test "enforces a sliding one-minute window and recovers automatically after the burst stops" do
    attacker_ip = "198.51.100.12"
    start_time = Time.current.change(usec: 0)

    travel_to start_time do
      20.times do
        post book_search_path(@handbook), params: { search: "Thanks" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
        assert_response :success
      end

      travel 40.seconds

      10.times do
        post book_search_path(@handbook), params: { search: "Thanks" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
        assert_response :success
      end

      post book_search_path(@handbook), params: { search: "Thanks" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
      assert_response :too_many_requests

      # 61 seconds after start_time: the initial 20 expired, 10 from +40s remain in window
      travel 21.seconds

      20.times do
        post book_search_path(@handbook), params: { search: "Thanks" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
        assert_response :success
      end

      post book_search_path(@handbook), params: { search: "Thanks" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
      assert_response :too_many_requests

      # Within 5 minutes of the burst stopping, the address is served again
      travel 5.minutes

      post book_search_path(@handbook), params: { search: "Thanks" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
      assert_response :success
    end
  end

  test "does not block a different address or opening the book pages while one address is refused" do
    attacker_ip = "198.51.100.13"
    reader_ip = "198.51.100.14"

    30.times do
      post book_search_path(@handbook), params: { search: "Thanks" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
      assert_response :success
    end

    post book_search_path(@handbook), params: { search: "Thanks" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => attacker_ip }
    assert_response :too_many_requests

    # Another unauthenticated reader at a different address still gets results on the same book
    post book_search_path(@handbook), params: { search: "Thanks" }, headers: { "REMOTE_ADDR" => reader_ip }

    assert_response :success

    assert_response :success
  end

      30.times { assert SearchRateLimiter.allow?(fallback_ip) }
      assert_not SearchRateLimiter.allow?(fallback_ip)
    end
  end
end
